title: Michael Pento: Stocks Could Crash 50% - Here’s What I’m Buying Instead
speaker: Michael Pento

macro_themes.view: Equities, credit and real estate bubbles will burst concurrently, most likely in 2027.
Fed under Warsh must hike 3-5 more times and shrink the balance sheet to fight ~3.7% inflation, triggering a steep recession.
A liquidity crisis forces the Fed back to 0-1% and trillions in printing, leading to hyper-stagflation.
Long-term yields keep rising; he bought 1-3 year Treasuries near 5% expecting 2027 cuts to 1%.
Net neutral long/short; holds dividend stocks, utilities, staples, healthcare, aerospace & defense.

calls.reason: Triple bubble in equities, credit and real estate; rising borrowing costs pop credit first, dragging stocks; market cap/GDP 235% must fall toward 100%.
calls.quote: these bubbles... will break in 2027... you're talking about a more than a 50% drop

calls.condition: Would sell even physical gold heading into a liquidity crisis; buy aggressively once Fed slashes rates and prints.
calls.reason: Rising nominal and real rates are a headwind near term; after the next recession, money printing crushes real yields and gold goes to record highs.
calls.quote: I still own about a 5% position in physical gold... You don't want to own a lot of gold in an era where... real interest rates rising.

calls.condition: Re-enter miners with both feet when the Fed starts slashing rates and printing money.
calls.reason: In a liquidity crisis everything is sold, especially miners; after Fed reliquefies they are a prime buy.
calls.quote: I sold my miners... when the fed starts slashing interest rates... jump both feet into both the miners and the physical

calls.reason: Fed needs 3-5 more hikes; deficits, foreign selling and AI debt issuance keep pushing yields up; the 35-year bond bull market is over.
calls.quote: those are the reasons why I believe interest rates are headed higher

calls.condition: Dollar likely spikes during the liquidity crisis, then falls once the Fed prints.
calls.reason: Fed will cut to 0-1% and monetize $4-6T deficits, burning the dollar.
calls.quote: I think that the dollar is, is burnt. It gets toasted.

calls.reason: Chips are the most overcrowded trade in history; he holds no tech except a small software sleeve.
calls.quote: chips are the most overcrowded trade on the planet's history

notes: Recorded ~Oct 20-21 (listing '19 hours ago'). Short-end view (2y yields fall after 2027 Fed cuts) differs from long-end view (yields rise); TNX reflects the long end. Pento said 'first two quarters of 2026' but context implies 2027. SMH used as proxy for 'chips'.
